entries.angle: After a week of pure escalation coverage, the story turns: both sides halt strikes and Trump pushes an immediate ceasefire, with each side's terms laid out.
entries.headline: 以色列和伊朗停手　川普推停火

entries.angle: xAI ships an agentic coding CLI and an image-to-video model, opening a packed June release wave (Gemini 3.5, new Claude, GPT-5.5 all imminent) — the first fresh model-release story since the early-June Microsoft cluster.
entries.headline: xAI推出寫程式和做影片新工具

entries.angle: The ECB's annual report quantifies how little the dollar's dominance has eroded — euro stuck at 20%, dollar at 57% — a fresh economics angle after weeks of no economics coverage.
entries.headline: 歐洲央行：美元還是老大

entries.angle: The first American pope makes the first-ever papal address to Spain's parliament, framing his transatlantic voice around 'moral renewal' and institutional decay.
entries.headline: 美國籍教宗在西班牙國會演講

entries.angle: A roster/depth story — Shaw activated while four starters sit injured ahead of a brutal Coors Field series — rather than another game-result recap.
entries.headline: 小熊投手受傷多　蕭歸隊

entries.angle: The post-final reckoning shifts from result recap to consequences: Arteta clears out a senior backroom figure and opens a summer rebuild.
entries.headline: 兵工廠賽季後改組　辭退醫療主管

entries.angle: Yesterday the paper only flagged a 'new Claude' as imminent; today Anthropic actually ships Claude Fable 5, beating GPT-5.5 and pairing it with a guardrail-relaxed Mythos 5 for vetted cyber/bio use — a genuine capability-and-safety milestone, not just a price tweak.
entries.headline: 新的克勞德問世　多項測驗贏過對手

entries.angle: A first-ever crossover — solar generates more US electricity than coal — a structural milestone the paper hasn't touched, with the open question of low-solar-hour grid reliability.
entries.headline: 太陽能首度超越煤炭

entries.angle: A month after the Cloudflare job-cuts story, fresh Q2 data reframes AI's labour effect as bifurcation, not just loss — a 56% wage premium for AI-skilled workers alongside 32,000 automation layoffs.
entries.headline: 會用AI　薪水多五成

entries.angle: Shifts the AI story from capabilities to who governs them: Colorado's first comprehensive state AI law goes live June 30, colliding with a White House preemption push and the EU AI Act — a distinct regulatory angle the paper hasn't run.
entries.headline: AI該誰管　州和中央爭不停

entries.angle: Breaks a run of Cubs stories with a fresh Michigan offseason build — a same-day transfer-portal haul (Thiam, Estrella, Reed plus a top-25 recruit) reshaping the 2026-27 roster.
entries.headline: 密大籃球補進三名高大球員

entries.angle: Distinct from yesterday's backroom-shakeup/rebuild angle: a specific player-fitness story — Timber pulls out of the Dutch World Cup squad injured, clouding his pre-season, while Saliba returns for France.
entries.headline: 提姆伯受傷　退出荷蘭世界盃

entries.angle: A major local disaster on the reader's doorstep — a multi-tornado outbreak that knocked out power to hundreds of thousands and damaged schools across northern Illinois and Indiana, now in its recovery phase.
entries.headline: 龍捲風侵襲芝加哥一帶　數十萬戶停電

entries.angle: A genuine policy decision, not currency-share data — the ECB's first rate hike since 2023, reversing a year of cuts because the Iran conflict's Hormuz threat has reignited energy inflation.
entries.headline: 歐洲央行兩年多來首次升息

entries.angle: Chicago's $36B pension hole becomes a live political fight as the council challenges the mayor's split-payment plan and Mendoza weaponizes it for the campaign — a fresh local-governance angle the paper hasn't run.
entries.headline: 芝加哥退休金缺口三百六十億　市議會逼問市長

entries.angle: A consequential, imminent SCOTUS decision on how far executive immigration-enforcement power extends — the legal backbone of the mass-deportation campaign, expected within weeks.
entries.headline: 美最高法院將裁定移民執法大案

entries.angle: An offseason recruiting story — Michigan lands 20 verbal commits and earns 'recruiting winner of June' honors — breaking from the recent Cubs-injury and Michigan-basketball entries with a distinct topic.
entries.headline: 密西根美式足球招兵大豐收

entries.angle: The transfer/financial-implications phase of the post-final arc: Arteta opens the window hunting a ~£100m midfielder (Kone, Casado linked), distinct from the earlier backroom-shakeup and Timber-injury angles.
